# Koja

> Koja is a statically typed programming language that compiles to native binaries through LLVM, with no garbage collector. It has a Rust-inspired type system, Swift-style value semantics, an Erlang-style concurrency model, and Ruby-inspired syntax.

The newest release is Koja {{ newest.version }}, released on {{ newest.date | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}. Koja is before version 1.0, and a minor release can include breaking changes. Read the changelog before you write code for a version.

## Docs

- [Language reference]({{ "/language/" | absolute_url }}): The syntax, the type system, concurrency, the standard library, and the tooling.
- [Installation]({{ "/install/" | absolute_url }}): How to install a prebuilt binary or build the compiler from source.
